translations.2026 전공하나에 참여한 학생들을 대상으로 결석계를 발급드릴 예정입니다: We plan to issue absence forms (결석계) for students who took part in 2026 Major One (전공하나).

who: Undergraduates who took part in 2026 전공하나

original.text: 2026 전공하나에 참여한 학생들을 대상으로 결석계를 발급드릴 예정입니다.
참가확인서 붙임파일 참고하시어 [교과목명, 학번, 성명] 작성 > 프린트 > 학부사무실(319호)에서 직인 받으신 후 각 강의 교수님께 제출하시기 바랍니다.
(각 강의 교수님께서 승인 여부 판단하실 예정입니다)

english: An absence certificate (결석계, a form that explains a class absence) will be issued to students who took part in 2026 전공하나 (Jeongong Hana, a department event).

Please see the attached participation confirmation (참가확인서) file. Fill in [course name, student ID number, name], print it, get the official stamp (직인) at the Undergraduate Office (Room 319), and then submit it to the professor of each course.
(The professor of each course will decide whether to approve it.)
*Other inquiries: 곽혜경 (Kwak Hye-kyung), Undergraduate Administration Office (ghk6081@snu.ac.kr, 880-1501)
